name: Sutton Advanced Cosmetic Dentistry
tagline: NYC market leaders in creating celebrity smiles
address: 400 East 56th St, Suite 1, New York, NY 10022
neighborhood: Sutton Place / Midtown East, Manhattan (near the Upper East Side)
hours: By appointment. The coordinator confirms exact times when you book.
insurance: The practice does not accept any form of dental insurance. Patients can usually submit receipts to their insurer for out-of-network reimbursement themselves.
consultation: Consultations are complimentary (free) and in person.

doctors.name: Dr. Mojgan Fajiram, DDS
doctors.bio: Founder. 30+ years of experience; one of NYC's leading cosmetic dentists, trusted by public figures, executives and international patients. Frequently featured in TV and magazine interviews on cosmetic dentistry.

doctors.name: Dr. Sheila Monahemi, DDS
doctors.bio: General and cosmetic dentist focused on comprehensive aesthetic dentistry and natural-looking porcelain veneers.

differentiators: On-site dental lab: veneers, crowns and inlays/onlays are handcrafted in-house
Many treatments completed in one visit (CEREC one-visit dentistry)
Pain-free techniques and a calm, spa-like office; anxious patients welcome
Every smile is designed for the individual face, not a generic set of teeth

services.name: Porcelain Veneers
services.summary: Ultra-thin, custom ceramic shells that correct chips, gaps, stains and shape. Hand-crafted in the on-site lab; stain-resistant and natural-looking.

services.name: Smile Makeover
services.summary: A fully customised plan combining veneers, whitening, bonding or crowns, designed around your facial features.

services.name: Dental Implants
services.summary: Natural-looking replacement for missing teeth that preserves bone and does not alter neighbouring teeth.

services.name: All-on-X / All-on-6
services.summary: A full fixed arch of teeth supported by implants, for patients missing most or all of their teeth.

services.name: Laser Teeth Whitening
services.summary: In-office whitening with professional gels and gum protection for fast, dramatic results with minimal sensitivity.

services.name: Invisalign
services.summary: Clear aligners to straighten teeth discreetly.

services.name: Porcelain Crowns
services.summary: Strong, lifelike crowns, often milled and placed in a single visit.

services.name: One-Visit Dentistry (CEREC)
services.summary: Digital scan, design and milling on-site so crowns and restorations can be completed the same day.

services.name: Teeth Bonding
services.summary: Tooth-coloured resin to repair small chips and gaps quickly.

services.name: Inlays & Onlays
services.summary: Conservative porcelain restorations that preserve more natural tooth structure than crowns.

services.name: Dental Bridges
services.summary: Fixed replacement for one or more missing teeth.

services.name: Full Mouth Reconstruction
services.summary: Comprehensive rebuilding of function and aesthetics across the whole mouth.

services.name: TMJ Treatment
services.summary: Relief for jaw pain, clicking and clenching.

services.name: Sleep Apnea Screening
services.summary: Screening and oral-appliance options for snoring and sleep apnea.

services.name: Professional Cleanings
services.summary: Gentle hygiene visits with experienced hygienists.

services.name: Pain-Free Dentistry
services.summary: Comfort-first techniques and sedation options for anxious patients.

travel: Out-of-state patients: LaGuardia is 8 miles (about 15 min by car), JFK 16 miles (about 30 min), Newark 17 miles (about 30 min).
clientele: Public figures, executives, New Yorkers and international patients. Patient identities are kept strictly private.
